## WasmHostPlatform.httpFetch() method

Perform an HTTP request through the host's networking stack (issue \#239). [createNodeHost()](./wasm.createnodehost.md) implements this over the global `fetch`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
httpFetch(request: HttpFetchRequest): Promise<HttpFetchResponse>;
```

## Remarks

No core consumer calls this yet — the delegated-access port (a later issue) is the first real caller. A host that cannot supply real networking may still implement this and reject every call; the WASM core surfaces that as a `FetchError`<!-- -->.
